guideContent.strategyOverview: Sauron, the Dark Lord is a Grixis value engine that rewards you for casting spells and attacking. Every time an opponent casts a spell, Sauron amasses Orcs, growing a single massive Army token. When your Army deals combat damage, the Ring tempts you, providing card selection and graveyard fuel. The deck maximizes these triggers through amass synergies, evasion for the Army token, and leveraging the graveyard through reanimation.

winConditions.title: Lethal Army Swing
winConditions.description: Sauron amasses Orcs every time an opponent casts a spell, growing a single massive Army token. In the Darkness Bind Them adds menace Wraith tokens and repeated Ring temptation. Whispersilk Cloak or Aqueous Form makes the Army unblockable. A 15+ power Army with evasion one-shots opponents through commander damage or regular combat.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Strategic win path identification

winConditions.title: Worldgorger Dragon Infinite Mana
winConditions.description: Animate Dead targeting Worldgorger Dragon in the graveyard creates an infinite loop: Dragon exiles all other permanents including Animate Dead, which returns everything untapped. Float mana each cycle for infinite mana. Break the loop by targeting a different creature with Animate Dead. Use infinite mana to recast Sauron and amass an arbitrarily large Army, or fuel a lethal Stinging Study.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Strategic win path identification

winConditions.title: Breach the Multiverse Reanimation
winConditions.description: Ring temptation fills your graveyard through looting. Breach the Multiverse mills each player 10, then reanimates a creature and planeswalker from each graveyard. Steal opponents' best threats while deploying your own. Combined with cheaper reanimation (Reanimate, Animate Dead, Stitch Together), rebuild a dominant board from any position.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Strategic win path identification

winConditions.title: Draw Punishment Drain
winConditions.description: Notion Thief steals all opponents' card draws, triggering Orcish Bowmasters for each stolen draw (1 damage + Army growth). The One Ring draws increasing cards each turn, building your hand while opponents are locked out. Each opponent's draw step feeds Bowmasters damage. Over 2-3 turn cycles, cumulative drain and a growing Army token close the game.

synergies.title: Amass Snowball
synergies.description: Sauron amasses every time an opponent casts a spell. Call of the Ring tempts you on upkeep, triggering Sauron's Ring-bearer looting. In the Darkness Bind Them creates 3/3 Wraith tokens with menace over three chapters while repeatedly tempting you with the Ring, fueling Sauron's triggers.

synergies.title: Ring Temptation Card Engine

synergies.title: Graveyard Recursion
synergies.description: Ring temptation fills your graveyard with creatures. Reanimate brings back any creature for 1 mana. Animate Dead does the same from any graveyard for {1}{B}. Stitch Together returns a creature to battlefield with Threshold (trivial with Ring looting). Breach the Multiverse mills everyone 10, then steals a creature from each graveyard. Worldgorger Dragon + Animate Dead creates an infinite mana loop: Dragon exiles all other permanents including Animate Dead, which returns everything, float mana each cycle, break the loop by targeting a different creature.

highlights.name: Call of the Ring
